detail_text: NSN: 6135-00-883-9024 Quantity: Base 240 EA, Option of 145 percent of the base FAT, LAT, and CDRLS are FOB Destination. Deliverable items are FOB Origin. Option: Yes. Paper copies of the solicitation will not be provided by the Navy. First article testing, production lot testing, contractor data requirements list, FOB origin and destination apply. This procurement is full and open with all responsible sources may submit an offer that, if received in a timely manner, will be considered. Based upon market research, the Government is not using the policies contained in Part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Items, in its solicitation for the described supplies or services. However, interested persons may identify to the contracting officer their interest and capability to satisfy the Government’s requirement with a commercial item within 15 days of this notice. The solicitation will be available no earlier than the response date for this synopsis.
